concerns.text: SC-005 ('architectural contribution... measured against the ablation study results comparing early attention heads vs. late feed-forward layers') has no anchoring User Story. US-1 covers compression variants, US-2 covers evaluation on subtle cues, and US-3 covers regression/sensitivity. None of the three stories explicitly include an ablation study of architectural components (attention vs. feed-forward) as a primary goal. This SC appears to be scope creep or an orphaned requirement.

FR-005 ('System MUST perform a regression analysis...') and FR-006 ('System MUST execute a sensitivity analysis...') are anchored to US-3, which is correct. However, FR-005 also implies identifying the 'breaking point' which is the core of the research question. While anchored to US-3, the specific 'ablation' aspect mentioned in SC-005 is missing from the FR list entirely. There is no FR describing the execution of an ablation study (freezing/pruning specific components) to isolate architectural contributions, creating a gap between the research question and the functional requirements.
